{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background and expose an Alpine login prompt reachable via telnet 127.0.0.1 6665, then block until readiness is confirmed.","required_artifacts":["A running QEMU process launched from /app/alpine.iso","Launch log or receipt showing the exact QEMU invocation and background start","Probe receipt showing a successful connection to 127.0.0.1:6665 with an Alpine login prompt"],"required_behaviors":["QEMU must remain running in the background after launch","Host port 6665 must forward to the guest login service","A telnet connection to 127.0.0.1:6665 must present a login prompt before finalization"],"known_invalid_patterns":["Only verifying that files exist","Only verifying that QEMU starts without confirming the login prompt","Only checking that port 6665 is open without prompt content","Launching QEMU in the foreground so the task is not left running","Using a different host port than 6665"],"verification_plan":["Inspect visible files and any prior receipts for launch details","Determine an appropriate QEMU command for Alpine ISO boot with serial/telnet access","Start QEMU detached/backgrounded and capture a launch receipt","Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed and record the receipt"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and background process start","Receipt-backed evidence of a telnet/probe connection to 127.0.0.1:6665","Receipt-backed evidence that the connection displayed an Alpine login prompt"],"notes":["Preserve the original user objective over any derived state.","Use receipts instead of repeating equivalent checks."]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"cd /app && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort","timeout":120000}]}
